legacy_original_window_fit.model: OLS peak and cumulative production on ln(slot), less explicit expected salary by slot
legacy_original_window_fit.target: 4 x mean(best two first-four production years) + .8 x (sum first-four production - salary)
legacy_original_window_fit.holdout_scope: Historical outcome OLS; explicit forward salary schedule is a separate cost repricing
legacy_original_window_fit.quote_equation: peak-production OLS + .8 x (cumulative-production OLS - explicit expected rookie salary)
legacy_original_window_fit.reference_salary_environment: 2026-27 published rookie scale; historical inventory uses the same normalized fixed-model price environment
legacy_original_window_fit.negative_quote_policy: Zero floor on generic pick total; annual components reconcile to floored total
